Aisha — sending the artifacts Sean promised. Notes inline in the workbook, and a short technical summary below. Let me know if you want a quick call to walk through the diagram.

Technical summary (short):
- Control plane (Redwood-managed): API gateway, orchestration, model catalog. No customer data stored here beyond metadata (customer ID, usage metrics).
- Data plane (customer workload): inference inputs and outputs flow through a deployment-specific VPC when using Dedicated/Private. For Hosted API, we offer configurable data residency + automatic KV/prefix caching that is encrypted and TTL-limited.
- Storage: encrypted at rest (AES-256). Keys are customer-specific in Dedicated/Private via KMS; hosted customers can use Redwood-managed KMS or bring-your-own-key (BYOK) for higher assurance.
- Transfer: for cross-border transfers we rely on DPA + SCCs; evidence provided in SIG workbook points to our SCC implementation and subprocessors list.

Action items for Medica Security: please confirm whether the test corpus will include PHI at rest and which AWS region you prefer. That will determine the BAA recommendation from our legal team.
